repo_notes.content: MCPJam/inspector is an npm workspaces monorepo for testing and debugging MCP servers. Most product work happens in mcpjam-inspector/ (React client in client/, Hono server in server/, code shared by both in shared/, Electron shell in src/). Prioritize mcpjam-inspector/, sdk/, cli/ and design-system/ over the internal apps (soundcheck/, slack-app/, discord-app/, surface-core/). Ignore the untracked HTML, Markdown and spreadsheet files at the repo root; they are not part of the product.
repo_notes.author: MCPJam

repo_notes.content: design-system/src/tokens.css is the single source of truth for colors. DESIGN.md's front matter and the token blocks in docs/style.css and chat-ui/src/styles.css are generated from it by npm run design:sync. Document this as a rule, not as an implementation detail.
repo_notes.author: MCPJam

repo_notes.content: Server logging and error reporting is a deliberate design: logger.error goes to Sentry and Axiom, warnings go to Axiom only, and route catch sites call reportRouteFailure (server/utils/route-error-report.ts) with a hop of user_server_hop or mcpjam_internal so a user's broken MCP server does not page MCPJam. See mcpjam-inspector/docs/server-error-reporting.md.
repo_notes.author: MCPJam
